audio_quality.label: Audio quality
audio_quality.description: Use audio available to your account. Prefer a lower tier if the selected tier is unavailable; use a higher tier only when it is the only available resource. Restart playback to apply changes.

search_cache_minutes.label: Search cache duration (minutes)
search_cache_minutes.description: Cache search results to speed up repeated browsing. A duration of 1–10 minutes is recommended.

subscription_write.label: Subscription synchronization
subscription_write.description: Import Ximalaya subscriptions into MA. Adding or removing a library album also subscribes or unsubscribes on Ximalaya.

skip_sync.label: Skip intro and outro
skip_sync.description: Use the intro and outro settings from the Ximalaya app.

service_key.label: Service access key
service_key.description: Leave empty when pairing with the local service for the first time.

reauthorize.label: Sign in again using a QR code

client_json.label: Chinese client configuration JSON
client_json.description: Import the client configuration used by the backend to sign in.

api_connection.title: Connect Ximalaya
api_connection.description: Connect the local Ximalaya API service. Account settings and QR sign-in remain in Music Assistant.

client_config.title: Client configuration
client_config.description: Provide your Chinese Ximalaya client configuration.

scan_qr.title: Scan to sign in
scan_qr.description: Scan with the Chinese Ximalaya app and confirm. An expired QR code refreshes automatically.

manifest.description: Listen to Chinese Ximalaya albums, episodes and radio using your account and a local API backend.
